summary: Independent review of the 72 label-free runs (4 genotype-age groups x 3 biological replicates x FLAG/IgG IP x 3 fractions) found no blocker or important issues; values traced to PRIDE, the MCP paper (PMC9540350) and independently re-read .msf workflow parameters. Minor findings only.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent without producer transcript; review-lfq-2, did not read earlier review-* dirs; primary sources re-fetched independently

spec_compliance.evidence: Resolved ms-proteomics 1.1.0, vertebrates 1.1.0, clinical-metadata 1.0.0 with spec/scripts/resolve_templates.py: no unlicensed columns, no missing required columns (only recommended characteristics[cell type] absent); not available used only where allow_not_available is true (sex, fractionation method); vertebrates/ms-proteomics/clinical-metadata pairwise not mutually exclusive; source+assay+label and source+biorep+techrep+fraction unique (0 duplicates); modification syntax correct incl. PP=Protein N-term for Met-loss+Acetyl.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 by obo_id, all non-obsolete with exact labels in defining ontology: NCBITaxon:10090, UBERON:0000956, MONDO:0007739, PATO:0000461, EFO:0001272, PRIDE:0001013, PRIDE:0000905, MS:1002523, MS:1001251, PRIDE:0000627, MS:1000422, PRIDE:0000609, PRIDE:0000600, MS:1000484, UNIMOD:4/35/7/766. material type 'tissue' in fixed list; sample type values in PRIDE:0000895 children list; C57BL/6J exists as EFO:0000606.

source_evidence.evidence: Paper (PMC9540350, title HTT-OMNI, cites PXD034158): Htt3xFlagQ20/+ and Q140/+ C57BL/6J mice, male and female (sex matched within replicate, no per-sample sex), cortex, 2 and 10 months, 3 biological replicates per genotype-age with parallel IgG IPs, TCEP/chloroacetamide, trypsin, 3 StageTip fractions, DDA on Q Exactive HF, mods Carbamidomethyl C fixed, Ox M, Deamidated N, Met-loss+Acetyl protein N-term variable. Independently range-read 20210818_10M-20Q-FLAG_F.msf tail: Sequest node Trypsin (Full), 4 ppm / 0.02 Da, same mods (15 ppm/0.1 Da belong to the recalibration node). PRIDE v3 record: Q Exactive HF, Mus musculus.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions == PXD034158): 84 .raw; this SDRF lists 72 unique, the SILAC sibling 12 unique, overlap 0, missing 0, extra 0; all vendor .raw. Replicate assignment re-verified from raw paths (repN\ folders) inside 3 deposited .msf files (20210806_2M-140Q-FLAG_F, 20210818_10M-20Q-FLAG_F, 20210821_2M-20Q-IgG_F) and matches the SDRF and the producer's map for all 24 sets.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 4 groups (2M/10M x Q20/Q140), 3 biological replicates each, FLAG and IgG IP per replicate, F1-F3 fractions = 72 runs, matching the paper's design; biological replicate numbering restarts per group; disease/genotype/age/sample type consistent with file names; technical replicate 1 (rerun files are the only deposited copy).

omission_safety.evidence: No per-sample sex, age or demographics invented (sex = not available as the paper gives none per replicate); fractionation method left not available rather than guessing a chemistry; HCD/orbitrap inferred from instrument and disclosed; no material evidence found that the SDRF omits beyond the minor items listed.

deterministic_validation.evidence: Reviewer-run flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf with bare template names: -t ms-proteomics exit 0 ('Everything seems to be fine'); -t vertebrates exit 0 (warning only: C57BL/6J not in ncbitaxon); -t clinical-metadata exit 0. sdrf-tools score 98/100. sdrf-tools check exit 1 solely on 'Met-loss+Acetyl' flagged as hallucinated, a false positive (UNIMOD:766 label verified exact in OLS). Union run not completed due to shared-lock queue; each template passed individually.

findings.message: factor value[age] (2M/10M) has no mirroring characteristics column; sdrf-tools score flags it (Design 83).
findings.evidence: README says a factor value typically mirrors a characteristic (SHOULD); characteristics[age] is licensed only by the human template, so this is a documented spec gap, not an error.

findings.message: sdrf-tools check reports Met-loss+Acetyl as hallucinated; false positive.
findings.evidence: OLS4 UNIMOD:766 label 'Met-loss+Acetyl', non-obsolete; .msf Sequest node and paper confirm.

findings.message: not available although StageTip (SDB-RPS per PXD025510) fractionation is described.
findings.evidence: No exact PRIDE fractionation term for SDB-RPS StageTip; reserved word is a defensible choice.
